text.en:
Grants 40 Reload Speed and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier while out of Combat.

For One Quiet Moment, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds. Kills reduce this to 1.5 seconds until damage is dealt or received.

Can activate even if stowed.

Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier while out of Combat. Can activate while stowed.

Swords receive up to a 25% increase to Movement Speed instead.

For One Quiet Moment, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds. Scoring any kill even with the weapon stowed reduces this to 1.5 seconds.

After not having exchanged damage for 1 second:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.

After not having exchanged damage for 2 seconds:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 5% decresed Reload Duration. Swords receive up to a 25% increase to Movement Speed instead.

Can activate while stowed.
